# Latitude and Doubt: an exact ledger of meaning in messages

> Preprint by Moustafa Mahmoud Atta (v1.0, 29 Sep 2026). For a source pairing meaning W with form X, entropy splits exactly: E = I + Λ and C = I + Δ, with latitude Λ = H(X|W) (speaker's freedom) and doubt Δ = H(W|X) (listener's uncertainty). Measured on six genomes (Λ = 1.235 to 1.501 bits per codon; 90,127 bits hidden in 240 real E. coli genes, proteins unchanged) and on English (SemCor, 22 wordnets).

- [Explainer page](https://4t1a.github.io/Latitude-Doubt/): definitions, live calculator, charts, FAQ
- [Paper PDF](https://4t1a.github.io/Latitude-Doubt/Latitude_Doubt.pdf)
- [Paper (DOI)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23287286)
